experimentLaw: Same source data, same CRM state, same Agile operating cycle, same timestamp. Governance visibility is the only variable.

OFF.label: Governance Off
hides: Correspondence conflicts not already reported by CRM
OFF.law: OFF must remain a credible useful operating system and must never be intentionally degraded to make governance appear valuable.

ON.label: Governance On
ON.law: ON is an additive evidence/qualification layer. It must not mutate CRM facts, workflow stages, schedules, Agile completion records, or source evidence merely by being enabled.

globalState.law: Changing mode anywhere changes the presentation mode everywhere on the ABC Roofing demonstration.

comparisonExamples.on: Display CRM state plus governance qualification and any evidence correspondence discrepancy.
Display recorded completion plus whether required evidence establishes completion.

protectedBoundaries: Governance mode does not change source records.
Governance mode does not fabricate failures.
Governance mode does not send external communications.
Governance OFF does not hide ordinary CRM-native warnings or Agile-native blockers.
Synthetic client data remains clearly identified as synthetic.
